interop-openai

First-party OpenAI interoperability for Tiinex — environment-specific grounding, capability integration, constraints and automation support over provider-agnostic Tiinex Interop and Core contracts.

Grounding boundary:
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-interop-openai.workspace.md` and the Workspace fresh-start Reduction under `.topics/reductions/workspace/`.
- Historical refactor work is reduced; no prior refactor Task is current. Future OpenAI-specific work starts from a new explicit bounded Task with truthful Project ancestry.
- Do not move provider-agnostic or shared semantic mechanics here merely because an OpenAI host exposes the first concrete need.
